How it works

Simple to understand. Precise in practice.

Six steps between a guest’s message and a perfect answer — with your team in control the whole way.

01

Unit data is structured at onboarding

Access codes, building rules, parking, WiFi, appliances, arrival procedures and known quirks — captured per property, in a structured knowledge layer.

02

Conviva learns that unit deeply

The AI uses the exact operational details of that unit — and only that unit. No generic knowledge. No guessing.

03

Guests message on WhatsApp as normal

No app to download, no signup, no friction. Guests use the channel they already know and trust.

04

Conviva replies with unit-specific accuracy

Every answer is grounded in real property details — door codes, appliance models, building procedures — not general assumptions.

05

Your team monitors from Chatwoot

All conversations across all units flow into one organised interface. One VA can oversee many properties at once.

06

Humans step in when it matters

Complaints, maintenance, frustration, edge cases — Conviva hands over cleanly, with full context already in place.

Human + AI

This is not a chatbot. It is an extension of your team.

Hospitality requires human care — and Conviva protects it. By absorbing the complex and the repetitive, it frees your team to step in for the moments of genuine care that define a stay.

Conviva handles

  • Building access, codes and arrival flow
  • Unit-specific appliance quirks and resets
  • Parking, directions and Google Maps links
  • WiFi, TV and how-to video guides
  • Voice messages — read and replied to
  • Late-night and out-of-hours queries
  • Recurring known issues, per unit
  • Local area questions and conditions
  • Pre-arrival and check-in instructions
  • Escalation to the right person

Your team steps in for

  • Complaints requiring a genuine apology
  • Maintenance visits and urgent follow-ups
  • Refund or compensation decisions
  • Frustrated or upset guests
  • Situations requiring genuine empathy
  • Matters outside normal operational logic
  • Decisions needing human judgment

Conviva escalates early and cleanly — your team has full context before stepping in.

    FAQ

    Common questions, answered honestly.

    How long does onboarding take for a new unit?
    Onboarding is structured: once you provide the unit details, the AI layer is live within a short setup window. A self-serve operator portal is rolling out so you can manage unit data in real time yourself.
    Does Conviva.live actually know my unit, or is it just generic AI?
    Every property gets its own structured knowledge layer — access codes, quirks, parking, appliance guides, recurring issues, special instructions. The AI answers using only that unit’s data, so it never confuses apartment 204 with apartment 312. Precision is the core product feature.
    Can one VA manage more units with Conviva.live?
    Yes. With routine questions handled automatically and full context retained in every conversation, per-unit workload drops significantly — one person can oversee far more conversations from a single Chatwoot dashboard.
    Does Conviva.live work in multiple languages?
    Yes. Guests write in the language they are comfortable with — Russian, Arabic, Chinese, European languages and more — and Conviva replies in the same language, using the same accurate unit data. Your team no longer needs to cover every language your guests speak.
    What happens when my team takes over a conversation?
    Takeover is one click in Chatwoot. The AI steps back immediately, your operator continues in the same WhatsApp thread with the full conversation history in front of them, and the guest experiences one seamless conversation. Every message is labelled, so you always know what was AI and what was human.
    Does it work with WhatsApp Business API officially?
    Yes. Conviva runs on the official WhatsApp Business API, connected through 360dialog, an authorised WhatsApp Business Solution Provider, and operates in line with WhatsApp and Meta platform policies. No grey-market gateways, no unofficial clients.
    Will the replies feel robotic?
    No. Conviva is built for hospitality tone: warm, natural, human-feeling replies grounded in the real details of the unit. Because answers come from actual property data rather than canned scripts, they read like a knowledgeable team member — not a bot.
    What happens if a guest has a complaint or a real issue?
    Conviva escalates early and cleanly. Complaints, maintenance problems, frustration and anything requiring genuine empathy or judgment are flagged to your team immediately, with the full conversation context attached — so the right person steps in at the right moment, never too late.
    Does Conviva.live remember the full conversation with a guest?
    Yes. The full conversation history is retained for the stay, so guests never have to repeat themselves — and when your team takes over, they see everything that was said before stepping in.
    What happens to unit knowledge when my VA leaves?
    Nothing is lost. With Conviva, operational knowledge lives in the structured knowledge layer — not in someone’s head. When a team member leaves, every access code, quirk and procedure stays exactly where it was, and a new VA is productive from day one.
    Does Conviva.live replace my VA or team?
    No — it is an extension of your team, not a replacement. Conviva absorbs the repetitive and the routine so your people can focus on the moments that genuinely need human care: complaints, judgment calls, and personal attention. Most operators keep the same team and simply cover far more units with it.
    Do guests need to install anything?
    No. Guests simply message on WhatsApp, exactly as they already do. No app to download, no account to create, no friction of any kind.
